en_title: Yes, There Was One Thing Cut from GTA 6 for Australia, NZ
cn_title: 没错，《GTA 6》确实为澳大利亚和新西兰删掉了一项内容
opus_summary: 《GTA 6》澳大利亚版无法让玩家使用物品栏中的可卡因暂时增强耐力，据报道新西兰版也一样。澳大利亚规定游戏中的违禁药物使用不能带来玩法增益；该版本仍保留肾上腺素增强功能及剧情中的可卡因使用。

paragraphs.en: The Australian version of Grand Theft Auto 6 does differ from the international version in one small way; players down under are not able to use cocaine from their personal inventory to briefly overpower their stamina bar. NZ reportedly has the same version.
paragraphs.cn: 澳大利亚版《GTA 6》与国际版确实有一处细微差别：澳大利亚玩家无法从个人物品栏中使用可卡因，来短暂增强体力条。据报道，新西兰也是同一版本。

paragraphs.en: In GTA 6, baggies of cocaine can be collected (or skimmed from full bricks) and show up as a consumable on the item wheel in the same section as cigarettes, cigars, and joints. Using one triggers a buff that puts stamina in an overpowered state, albeit only for about 30 seconds. This function was never included in the Australian-specific version of the game, as it would have prevented GTA 6 from being classified in the country until it was removed. Australia’s classification laws allow illicit drug use in games, but using them can’t provide the player with gameplay benefits.
paragraphs.cn: 在《GTA 6》中，玩家可以收集一小袋一小袋的可卡因（或从整砖可卡因中取出一些），它们会作为消耗品出现在物品轮盘上，与香烟、雪茄和大麻卷烟位于同一区域。使用一袋可卡因会触发增益效果，让体力进入强化状态，不过只能持续约30秒。游戏的澳大利亚专属版本从未包含这一功能，因为这一功能若不被移除，《GTA 6》就无法在该国获得分级。澳大利亚的分级法律允许游戏中出现使用非法毒品的情节，但使用毒品不能给玩家带来游戏内的好处。

paragraphs.en: Overpowering your stamina (and everything else) is still possible via the use of adrenaline in the Australian version of GTA 6, and it’s also still possible to drink and smoke whenever you want. The general use of cocaine in story moments also still remains in the Australian version of GTA 6, because these instances aren’t associated with any in-game buffs.
paragraphs.cn: 在澳大利亚版《GTA 6》中，玩家仍然可以通过使用肾上腺素来强化体力（以及其他所有能力），也仍然可以随时喝酒和抽烟。故事情节中一般性的可卡因使用场景也保留在澳大利亚版《GTA 6》中，因为这些场景与任何游戏内增益效果都没有关联。

paragraphs.en: While the caveat that forbids rewards for illicit drug use is bespoke to Australia – and doesn’t apply to NZ – NZ’s rating system (which does piggyback on some Australian and UK classification decisions for unrestricted content ) has its own idiosyncrasies. These recently caught out IllFonic’s recent Halloween multiplayer game , which was refused classification in Australia for illicit drug use linked to an incentive or reward (that is, that use of the drug provides a gameplay advantage to the player). Halloween since made its way to NZ, but not Australia. Since this is not Rockstar’s first rodeo, it knew exactly the tweak GTA 6 would require to skirt this continuing quirk in Australian video game ratings and avoid multiple submissions.
paragraphs.cn: 虽然禁止对使用非法毒品给予奖励的限制是澳大利亚独有的，并不适用于新西兰，但新西兰的分级体系（对于不受限制的内容，确实会沿用澳大利亚和英国的部分分级决定）也有其自身的特殊规定。这些规定最近让IllFonic近期推出的《月光光心慌慌》多人游戏栽了跟头：该游戏因将使用非法毒品与激励或奖励挂钩（即使用毒品会给玩家带来游戏内优势）而在澳大利亚被拒绝分级。此后，《月光光心慌慌》登陆了新西兰，但没有登陆澳大利亚。由于Rockstar对此并非毫无经验，它很清楚《GTA 6》需要做出什么调整，才能绕过澳大利亚电子游戏分级中这一延续至今的特殊规定，避免多次提交审核。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 arrived late last week, crushing records and becoming the biggest entertainment launch of all time, with retail sales soaring to $3.79 billion in its first 24 hours. In my review for IGN I called it “the single most impressive video game I have ever played,” a sentiment shared by developers similarly stunned by how radically advanced it is.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA 6》于上周晚些时候推出，打破多项纪录，成为有史以来规模最大的娱乐作品首发，其零售销售额在首个24小时内飙升至37.9亿美元。在为IGN撰写的评测中，我称它是「我玩过的最令人惊叹的电子游戏，没有之一」。一些开发者也有同感，他们同样被它如此超前的表现所震撼。

paragraphs.en: Just getting started in GTA 6, or wondering what to do next? You can get stuck into the Official Grand Theft Auto 6 guide right here on IGN, consult our Beginner's Guide or Leonida interactive map , or get an idea of all the incredible flourishes to keep an eye out for by checking out our look at 99 incredible details you can find in GTA 6.
paragraphs.cn: 刚开始玩《GTA 6》，或者不知道接下来该做什么？你可以直接在IGN上深入阅读《GTA 6》官方指南，查阅我们的新手指南或Leonida互动地图，也可以看看我们盘点的《GTA 6》中可以发现的99个惊人细节，了解有哪些值得留意的精彩细节。
